title: COMBINA sits on the GAMMALN wall: one decisive witness, no pass count
status_plain: COMBINA(20,7) = C(26,7) returns 657799.9999999999, one ULP below the exact integer 657800 -- which a product cannot produce. That single witness is what identifies the substrate as exp(gammaln) and reduces COMBINA to the GAMMALN wall. Production does NOT implement the identified substrate: `combina_kernel` is a product. No per-surface pass count exists for COMBINA anywhere. The formal reduction to GAMMALN is a designed recipe that has not been executed.
substrate: `exp(gammaln)`, not a product -- reduces to the GAMMALN/x87 wall
ruled_out: a product kernel for COMBINA: impossible given the sub-integer witness
open_question: The recipe to formally reduce COMBINA to GAMMALN -- capture GAMMALN(n+k)/(k+1)/(n) plus EXP at the COMBINA argument triples -- is designed and not executed.
reader_warning: This record publishes no pass count. The 26-row mismatch figure in the BUG-FUNC-027 cycles covers COMBIN and COMBINA jointly and is recorded once, on EV-MATH-0016; it counts mismatches, not passes.
